title: Objects on radar and seen by airmen over Malmstrom

tellings.quote: And in the meantime, there are reports at Malmstrom Air Force Base. Objects are seen on radar. Objects are seen by airmen at the base.

plain: In 1967, objects showed up on radar at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, a base for nuclear missiles, and airmen at the base saw them with their own eyes. Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer who served there, tells it as reports that came in at the time, citing an officer named Lewis Chase. He raises it because it would mean the unknown objects were watched closely around America's nuclear weapons.
